independentReview.mode: independent read-only code review; scratch report only
independentReview.identity_verification: All eight actual worktree files, supplied report and patch match sealed identities. Current JobQueue/Coordinator/Controller/Policy exactly match candidate worktree contracts.
independentReview.conclusion: No concrete integration blocker found in this Java-only slice under its documented trusted-producer/coordinator contract. Native activation remains blocked by the explicitly unrun native producer and borrowed stream gates; this is not end-to-end scheduler approval.

contract_review.finding: Position and immutable Pending are reserved before fallible registration; submission is appended only after successful registration. Reentrant registration fails before consuming another position, and an escaping collaborator failure latches terminal session fault. Producer admission drains submissions FIFO before queue cycle. Java test covers uncaught reentry and sticky failure; collaborators remain trusted not to drive the queue.

Queue-global strictly increasing ordinal and action-local positive counter are recorded separately before factory use. Aborted retry retains request name/discovery position, increments only its action-local counter, and uses a fresh global ordinal. Resource-free factory exceptions are terminal through actual queue/coordinator, with issued identity retained for diagnosis.

Only issued matching unconsumed global identities are accepted. Actual coordinator supplies native queue outcomes, including older aborted outcome records even if its next attempt was created in the same successful cycle. Aborted outcome is retained without final response; non-aborted payload passes by reference without exit-code conversion. Session itself supplies correlation, not independent native result authority.

The final response flag and consumed outcome are committed before fallible publication. Send failure is sticky and stops the whole invocation; later operations cannot resend. Coordinator cleanup closes actual queue owners before invocation lifetime cleanup. No automatic response resend exists.

Mutating and observational session/platform methods check constructing-thread affinity before touching collaborators or registries. Names/original Windows positions remain reserved after cleanup. Current coordinator independently checks hasOpenAttempts before outer close, and session repeats that check. Expected happy-path one-shot cleanup is idempotent after success; uncertain cleanup intentionally remains terminal rather than automatically replaying arbitrary invocation code.

optional_improvements.title: Make recovery ownership after outer cleanup failure explicit before native activation
optional_improvements.observation: After invocation.close throws, closeAttempted permanently prevents another CargoSession.close call from reaching the retained invocation. That safely avoids blind replay but provides no session-mediated reconciliation. The native producer does not exist yet, so this is a lifecycle requirement to resolve for that owner rather than a demonstrated native leak in this slice.
optional_improvements.recommendation: State who retains/reconciles the invocation after partial close, and add a focused one-shot-failure/retained-owner check when the concrete invocation owner is supplied. Do not blindly retry uncertain response publication.

optional_improvements.title: Define expected wrapper exit after a final response
optional_improvements.observation: wrapperDisconnected unconditionally fails the session for any registered request, including responseAttempted requests. A native ingress must therefore distinguish normal post-response wrapper exit from unexpected pre-response loss before invoking it; no such ingress is supplied or claimed here.
optional_improvements.recommendation: Document that caller precondition or make the distinction explicit in the native producer, and exercise normal final-response -> wrapper reap alongside pre-response disconnect before enabling Cargo integration.

optional_improvements.title: Direct invalid-outcome checks would substantiate the ledger rejection claim
optional_improvements.observation: Code rejects missing identity, wrong action and already-consumed identity, but the focused session tests do not directly exercise those three branches. Existing end-to-end modeled happy retry verifies the intended ordinals.
optional_improvements.recommendation: Add only narrow invalid-ledger behavior checks when this boundary next changes; do not rerun passing broad suites for this review.
